records.title: 重点戦略の令和6年度進捗
records.statement: 重点戦略40KPIの令和6年度実績は、基準値に対して向上26、横ばい2、低下11、実績値を把握できず1と実施状況報告書の表9・表10で確認。
records.evidence_location: 実施状況報告書 表9・表10／PDF内部ページ775-776付近／印刷ページ772-773
records.review_note: 公式HTML集計が明示した向上26・低下11に加え、報告書表9・10で残る3件を横ばい2・実績把握できず1と確認。方向区分は市のsource-reported factであり、政策達成度や因果効果へ変換しない。

quality_boundary: Saitama Phase 13 separates the current 2021-2030 basic plan, current 2026-2030 implementation plan, historical 2021-2025 implementation cycle, fiscal-2024 progress evaluation, and fiscal states. The 370 project evaluation universe is an occurrence count including reposted projects; the official report states 299 unique projects after deduplication. Municipality A/B/C and measure/KPI progress labels are source-reported internal evaluations, not Jichi Insight achievement judgments. The full 40-KPI direction aggregate is source-verified as 26 above baseline, 2 flat, 11 below, and 1 unavailable. Current-plan subjective and objective outcome indicators remain separate measurement families, and no outcome change is promoted to causal effect or cross-city comparability.
next_action: Preserve the completed current project and target-identity universes, keep current outcome source-method verification and target-value depth as deferred layers, and evaluate whether the declared Saitama v1 review package satisfies the Phase 13 completion contract without crossing implementation-cycle or comparability boundaries.
